notes.body:
Hi Olivier,

Can you convert the dissector to standalone dissector (and not plugin ?)

This looks obsolete to me and should be done differently any way. If it is still nbeeded please comment on what needs to be done and we can try to do it moire Wirehark integrated. Like update CMS asn1?

changes_data.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+# CMakeLists.txt
+#
+# Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer
+# By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>
+# Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs
+#
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+#
+
+include(WiresharkPlugin)
+
+# Plugin name and version info (major minor micro extra)
+set_module_info(cms2007 0 0 4 0)
+
+set(DISSECTOR_SRC
+	packet-cms2007.c
+	helper.c
+	packet-x509af.c
+	packet-x509ce.c
+	packet-x509if.c
+	packet-x509sat.c
+)
+
+set(PLUGIN_FILES
+	plugin.c
+	${DISSECTOR_SRC}
+)
+
+set_source_files_properties(
+	${PLUGIN_FILES}
+	PROPERTIES
+	COMPILE_FLAGS "${WERROR_COMMON_FLAGS}"
+)
+
+include_directories(../../../epan)
+include_directories(../../../epan/dissectors)
+
+if(WIRESHARK_TARGET_PLATFORM STREQUAL "win64")
+	include_directories(../../../wireshark-win64-libs-4.0/libgcrypt-1.10.1-2-win64ws/installed/x64-windows/include)
+	include_directories(../../../wireshark-win64-libs-4.0/gnutls-3.6.3-1-win64ws/include)
+endif()
+
+register_plugin_files(plugin.c
+	plugin
+	${DISSECTOR_SRC}
+)
+
+add_plugin_library(cms2007 epan)
+
+target_link_libraries(cms2007 epan)
+
+if(WIRESHARK_TARGET_PLATFORM STREQUAL "win64")
+	target_link_libraries(cms2007 c:/Devel/wireshark/build/release-4.0-2022-10-08-es/wireshark/wireshark-win64-libs-4.0/libgcrypt-1.10.1-2-win64ws/installed/x64-windows/lib/libgcrypt.lib)
+	target_link_libraries(cms2007 c:/Devel/wireshark/build/release-4.0-2022-10-08-es/wireshark/wireshark-win64-libs-4.0/gnutls-3.6.3-1-win64ws/bin/libgnutls-30.lib)
+endif()
+
+install_plugin(cms2007 epan)
+
+file(GLOB DISSECTOR_HEADERS RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "*.h")
+CHECKAPI(
+	NAME
+	  cms2007
+	SWITCHES
+	  --group dissectors-prohibited
+	  --group dissectors-restricted
+	SOURCES
+	  ${DISSECTOR_SRC}
+	  ${DISSECTOR_HEADERS}
+)
+

+# Editor modelines  -  https://www.wireshark.org/tools/modelines.html

+# c-basic-offset: 8
+# tab-width: 8
+# indent-tabs-mode: t
+# End:
+#
+# vi: set shiftwidth=8 tabstop=8 noexpandtab:
+# :indentSize=8:tabSize=8:noTabs=false:
+#
